Method of Attack: Uses init.ps1 automatic execution script to run Chrome in incognito mode opening bitcoin price webpage
Repeated popup windows with messages indicating system compromise and Halloween-themed slogans
Discoverer: 奇安信技术研究院“天问”软件供应链安全监测平台
Attack Vector: Automatic execution of init.ps1 script during package installation
Indicators of Compromise: init.ps1 script in package versions 1.0.1 and 1.0.2
Use of Chrome incognito mode to open bitcoin price webpage
Repeated popup alerts with 'Trick or Treat' and warnings of being hacked
